name: HL7EuImagingManifest
title: IHEeu/HL7eu Imaging Manifest R4
description: This guide describes how a Imaging Manifest can be represented in the European REALM using FHIR R4.

resource.name: Anatomical Region
resource.description: A shortlist of anatomical regions that can be used for searching reports and manifests.

resource.name: Bundle: Imaging Manifest
resource.description: This profile represents a manifest of an imaging study. It holds the ImagingStudy resource that mirrors the information in the DICOM study allow with other resources that are required to express the information in DICOM in FHIR.

resource.name: EEHRxF Imaging Manifest Document Access Provider CapabilityStatement
resource.description:
CapabilityStatement for the EEHRxF Imaging Manifest Document Access Provider actor. This composite actor
provides access to EEHRxF FHIR Documents by serving them to Document Consumers via query APIs.

resource.name: EEHRxF Imaging Report Document Consumer CapabilityStatement
resource.description:
CapabilityStatement for the EEHRxF Imaging Report Document Consumer actor. This composite actor
consumes EEHRxF FHIR Imaging Report Documents by querying a Imaging Report Document Access Provider.

resource.name: EEHRxF MHD DocumentReference Profile for Imaging Reports
resource.description: Profile for DocumentReference resources used in the EEHRxF context, based on the IHE MHD Minimal DocumentReference profile. This profile is used for the DocumentReference resources that represent imaging manifests using the DICOM KOS format in the EEHRxF context. It includes additional constraints and extensions specific to imaging manifests, such as the type of report, the clinical specialty, and the anatomical region of interest.

resource.name: EEHRxF MHD DocumentReference Profile for Imaging Reports
resource.description: Profile for DocumentReference resources used in the EEHRxF context, based on the IHE MHD Minimal DocumentReference profile. This profile is used for the DocumentReference resources that represent imaging manifests using the FHIR format in the EEHRxF context. It includes additional constraints and extensions specific to imaging manifests, such as the type of report, the clinical specialty, the anatomical region of interest, and the profile of the imaging report.

resource.name: SearchParameterDocumentReferenceBodySite
resource.description: Searches for document references with a specific body site.

resource.name: SearchParameterDocumentReferenceModality
resource.description: Searches for document references with a specific modality.
